evidence_note: CALD Collections Outreach project (2026) engages community directly to inform collection purchasing; ABS Census and demographic data used as a planning tool; partnerships with several CALD community organisations. Not yet integrated into whole-of-library planning and resourcing (Level 5).

Community-language and English-learning collections defined in the Library Collection Development Policy (2.12, 2.13), aligned to SLNSW Living Learning Libraries; commitments in Library Strategy 2030 and Delivery Program. Dedicated budget lines and integrated staffing via Cultural Engagement and Library Services. Cross-cultural training provided but not compulsory for all staff (Level 5).

LOTE collections matched to local demographics (Chinese 15900+, Greek 2500+, plus Arabic, Nepali, Italian, Spanish, Tagalog); SLNSW bulk-loan access across 43 languages; Spydus catalogue displays non-Roman scripts. Active collecting of CALD oral histories and migration narratives (CDP 2.9, Local Studies) with dedicated Research and Community History rooms at Hurstville and Kogarah. Aligned to Library Strategy 2030 Action 2.6 and CREATE Cultural Strategy.

In-language promotion is data-driven; priority languages chosen from ABS Census figures under the Community Engagement Strategy 2023-2033. Translated flyers (Language Cafe in 10 languages), multilingual signage and banners, bilingual program campaigns, and multicultural social media kits including WeChat. Not yet consolidated into a single integrated multicultural communications strategy (Level 5).

Feedback and research with CALD participants via the CALD Collections Outreach survey (collected at Dashain, English Conversation Classes, Migrant Information Day, and online), Your Say, in-branch feedback, community organisations, and the Multicultural Advisory Committee. Council-wide channels offer portal translation and TIS interpreter access. Dedicated CALD research is currently English-only, which likely under-represents less English-confident residents. Level 4 requires client research provided in main community languages.
